title: Anonymous whistleblower on crash retrieval team in northern Nevada
place_text: Northern Nevada desert (former Nevada Test Range), USA

tellings.quote: initial, he was on a crash retrieval team in the northern Nevada desert way north. Used to be called the Nevada Test Range. And about I think it was 2009, somewhere around there, he was on a team retrieving these objects.

plain: Around 2009, a man is said to have served on a crash retrieval team, a crew that recovers downed craft of unknown origin, out in the far north of the Nevada desert, on land once called the Nevada Test Range. Steven Greer, a UFO researcher and activist, passes this on from an anonymous whistleblower who told him he was "on a team retrieving these objects." If true, such recoveries were still going on in recent years.
